tradefeedr.ParentOrderDefinition

Fetches parent orders for given parameters.

Available as lseg.data.content.tradefeedr.ParentOrderDefinition.

Syntax

ParentOrderDefinition(
    start: str,
    end: str,
    fields: str | list[str] | None = None,
    extended_params: None | dict = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
start str Yes Start of the period to get data for
end str Yes End of the period to get data for
fields str | list[str] | None No None Field(s) to request, if no fields are passed a default is used
extended_params None | dict No None extra paremeters for the backend request

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description

Returns

Response

Example

import lseg.data as ld
ld.content.tradefeedr.ParentOrderDefinition(
    start='2020-01-01',
    end='2024-01-01'
)
